summary: A family can name three things that changed but cannot tell a reporter which one produced its refund.
realLife: An Associated Press account entered in a 2019 House hearing record reported this case. Goodell reported higher withholding and more charitable giving and thought the larger child credit helped, without assigning a share to each change.
inGame: needs: a source describes several changes affecting the same filing season.
